The vertical axis is labeled "Average Performance (%)", ranging from 0 to 60 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 20. The bars are grouped in pairs, with each pair displaying two different colors, and the values range from 29.44% for the shortest bar to 68.66% for the tallest bar. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, such as descending or alphabetical, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular bar. The first pair of bars, colored green and purple, has values of 68.66% and 61.11%, respectively, while the subsequent pairs have varying values, with the lowest being 29.44% and 36.62% for the third pair, and the remaining pairs having relatively consistent values between 52.61% and 66.41%. The chart does not provide explicit labels for the categories or the bars, but the pairs are distinguishable by their colors, which include various shades such as blue, pink, brown, purple, yellow, gray, beige, and light pink.

The horizontal axis contains categories representing different LLMs, which are not explicitly labeled but are distinguished by different colors. The bars in the chart represent the average performance of each LLM, with values ranging from 29.44% to 68.66%; the highest value is 68.66%, and the lowest is 29.44%.
